ideas.title: A Day in Jannah: AI-visual long videos
ideas.hook: A long format for Ambient Escape with real search demand, no reciter audio needed
ideas.why: Ambient Escape's longs get 0-21 views (recitation longs also carry Content ID risk). An AI-visual 'Movie of Heaven' Islamic story got 1.4M views on a 38K-sub channel (SA Religious Voice, OutlierKit), and its 'Jahannam' video hit 131K at 82x. Omar's verse Shorts already earn ~9% like rates, so the audience is there.
ideas.impact: First Ambient long with a real chance at 1K-10K+ views; a repeatable weekly series (Jannah, the grave, the Day of Judgement, stories of the Prophets told without depictions)
ideas.effort: 4h to build the pipeline, then about 1h per video
ideas.cost: $0 with free stock clips and free-tier AI voice; AI images may need a paid tier
ideas.script:
1. Pick the first topic: 'A Day in Jannah, as the Quran describes it'.
2. Claude drafts a 15-20 min narration where every sentence is tied to a Quran ayah or sahih hadith; the reference shows on screen as it is said. Omar (or someone he trusts) checks every reference before upload.
3. Visuals: slow stock or AI landscapes (gardens, rivers, light, clouds). Never depict prophets, angels or Allah; no faces needed.
4. Audio: calm AI voice over his soft rain/wind bed from the ambient-escape-videos pipeline. No reciter audio.
5. Title test: 'A Day in Jannah 🌿 What the Quran Describes | Calm Islamic Story for Sleep'.
6. Thumbnail: bright garden + one short line.
Risks: inaccurate claims (fix with source checks), AI-image licence terms (check the tool's commercial terms), and 'repetitive content' if every video looks the same (vary topics and visuals).
Worked if: in 14 days it beats Ambient's best long (21 views) by 10x, or average view duration is over 3 minutes.
ideas.buildPrompt: I run the Ambient Escape YouTube channel (calm Islamic and sleep content). I use my Claude skill 'ambient-escape-videos' and my repo omarjaradat2006-sudo/agent-hq. I want to add a new long-form series: calm Islamic story videos with AI or stock visuals, e.g. 'A Day in Jannah, as the Quran describes it'. Please: 1) Write a 15-20 minute narration script for that first episode in calm, simple English, where EVERY claim is tied to a specific Quran ayah (surah:ayah) or a sahih hadith (collection + number), listed in a separate source table so I can check them; mark anything you're not sure of. 2) Give a scene list (timestamp, on-screen reference text, visual description) using only landscapes, light, water and gardens: no depictions of prophets, angels or Allah, and no faces. 3) Explain how to produce it with free tools: free stock clips from Pixabay/Pexels, a free or cheap AI voice (state its commercial-use terms), and my existing synthesized rain/wind bed; NO reciter audio. 4) Propose the changes to my ambient-escape-videos skill so it can make this format (I'll save the updated skill myself). 5) Give 3 title and thumbnail options. Don't post or upload anything.

ideas.title: Weapon Ball Battle format for sims.py
ideas.hook: A new 'who wins' sim with HP bars, built once, remixable forever
ideas.why: Three small channels are 3x outliers with ball battles (Cell Wars Game 1,629 at 3.2x; Seadog Ball Battles 1,143 at 3.0x and 1,061 at 2.8x), and a character-ball 'vs' video hit 1,195,688 at 3.5x (Velique). Omar's own 'who wins / pick a colour' Shorts already pull 1.4K-3.8K, so this extends a proven hook.
ideas.impact: A fresh format for 2-3 daily slots; if it matches his marble races that is +5K-10K views a day
ideas.script:
1. Add a 'weapon_battle' format to sims.py: two (later 4) balls bounce in a circle or square arena.
2. Each ball carries a simple drawn weapon (sword, spear, hammer) or shield, rotating with the ball.
3. Weapon tip hitting the other ball = damage; health bars at top; a hit flash and a synth 'clang' from the existing audio engine.
4. Last ball standing gets a 1-second slow-mo and 'WINNER' text.
5. Variables to remix: weapons, sizes, speed, arena shape, 'one gets stronger each hit'.
6. Title pattern: 'Sword vs Hammer... who wins? ⚔️ #shorts'. Use generic names only (no anime, Minecraft or game characters: copyright).
7. Put 2 slots in the 'winning elsewhere' block for a week.
Risks: fights that end too fast (tune HP so it lasts 20-30 s) or too random.
Worked if: after 7 days the median battle Short beats the channel's Short median.
ideas.buildPrompt: I run the Bounce Theory YouTube channel. My Shorts are made by my Python Bounce Engine (sims.py formats + synthesized audio) through my Claude skill 'bounce-theory-videos'; daily plans live in my repo omarjaradat2006-sudo/agent-hq (data/youtube/state.json). Please design and write a new sims.py format called 'weapon_battle': 2-4 balls bounce in an arena (circle or square); each ball has a simple drawn weapon (sword, spear, hammer) or a shield that rotates with it; when a weapon tip touches another ball it loses HP (health bars at the top), with a hit flash and a short synthesized clang; last ball standing gets 1 s of slow motion and 'WINNER' text. Fights should last 20-30 s at 1080x1920, 60 fps. Expose parameters (weapons, HP, speeds, arena shape, 'grows stronger each hit') so I can remix it daily. Use generic names only, never copyrighted characters. First ask me to paste my current sims.py (or its format interface) so the new format matches it exactly. Then propose the matching update to my bounce-theory-videos skill (I'll save it myself), and 5 title options in my style ('... who wins? ⚔️ #shorts').

sources.title: Levi vs Eren | Weapon Ball Battle

ideas.title: LinkedAI fresh-review engine
ideas.hook: More recent 5-star reviews now that the Chrome Web Store weights them
ideas.why: Google's Aug 20, 2026 update says extension ratings will weight recent reviews more, and the Featured badge program is ending (self-nominations closed). The LinkedAI team also found rivals' AI gets called 'generic' in reviews, so happy users praising personal messages are a selling point.
ideas.impact: Higher, fresher rating on the store listing; realistic +10-30% install conversion if the rating and review count rise (not guaranteed)
ideas.script:
1. Find LinkedAI's 'happy moment' (e.g. a user copies a generated message for the 3rd time, or marks 'got a reply').
2. At that moment only, show a small, dismissible prompt: 'Did LinkedAI help? A quick review helps a student developer a lot' with a button to the Chrome Web Store reviews page.
3. Never ask twice in 30 days; never block the UI; never offer rewards for reviews (against store policy).
4. If a user clicks 'not really', open a feedback form instead so complaints come to Omar, not the store.
5. Ship as a small version update (use the new pre-submission checks).
Risks: being pushy (keep it once, dismissible); store policy on incentives (none offered).
Worked if: in 14 days LinkedAI gets more new reviews than in the previous 2 months and the rating holds or rises.
ideas.buildPrompt: I built LinkedAI, a freemium LinkedIn Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that writes personal outreach messages. Chrome Web Store ratings now weight recent reviews more (Google's Aug 20, 2026 'Chrome Web Store updates' post) and the Featured badge program is ending, so I want a polite in-extension review prompt. Please: 1) Ask me to paste my manifest.json and the files where a message gets generated/copied. 2) Add a 'happy moment' trigger (e.g. after the 3rd copied message or when the user marks 'got a reply'), stored in chrome.storage.local, that shows one small dismissible prompt: 'Did LinkedAI help? A quick review helps a lot' with 'Leave a review' (opens my store listing's reviews page) and 'Not really' (opens a feedback form link I'll give you). 3) Rules: never more than once per 30 days, never blocks the UI, no rewards or incentives for reviews (Chrome Web Store policy), no new permissions if avoidable. 4) Give me the exact code changes, a version bump, and a short test plan. Don't publish anything; I'll upload it myself.

Your best upgrade is 'A Day in Jannah' for Ambient Escape: a sourced, calm narration over landscapes, no reciter audio.
